item.title: ASAP Act targets faster solar energy growth, $1 billion annual savings
item.description: New York lawmakers and advocates are pushing for the ASAP Act, which would double the state's solar energy goals and save residents up to $1 billion a year, but faces opposition from Republicans over safety concerns and local farmland loss.

item.title: New York State Senate passes environmental package to counter federal rollbacks
item.description: The New York State Senate Democratic Majority advanced nine bills to reduce industrial pollution, remove toxic chemicals from consumer goods, and increase corporate transparency, in response to environmental deregulation under the Trump administration.

item.title: How much extra daylight can we expect throughout February?
item.description: ELMIRA, N.Y. (WETM)- Throughout February, an increase in daylight becomes more noticeable, as a result of the Earth's axial tilt. Daylight increases by 70 minutes in February in the Twin Tiers, resulting in approximately 2 more minutes of light each day. The tilt of the earth impacts the seasons and the length of the days.
